main.description: Generic write SQL primitive (INSERT / UPDATE / UPSERT only). Strict guards: rejects SELECT (use sql.query) / DELETE / DROP / TRUNCATE / GRANT / DDL. Requires `confirmWrite=true` defense-in-depth flag. If `rows` is supplied, runs executemany() batch INSERT; otherwise single execute. Replaces per-actor sa_executemany / sa_rowcount py_primitive nodes (copyright_ingest insert_crossref, etc.).

sql.description: INSERT / UPDATE / UPSERT statement. Single statement; trailing semicolon optional.

params.description: Named bind params for single-row execute().

rows.description: Row dicts for batch executemany() — each dict's keys must match SQL named binds.
